title: Superessive Personal Pronouns: rajtam, rajtad, rajta...

sections.content:
The superessive case (*-on / -en / -ön*, meaning 'on') builds its personal pronoun paradigm from the stem **rajt-**:
- **rajtam** = on me
- **rajtad** = on you (singular)
- **rajta** = on him / her / it
- **rajtunk** = on us
- **rajtatok** = on you (plural)
- **rajtuk** = on them

items.english: The warm coat is on me (I am wearing it).
